reading.title: The Impact of Remote Work on Urban Development
reading.passage: The rise of remote work has fundamentally transformed urban planning strategies worldwide. As companies embrace flexible work arrangements, fewer employees commute to city centers daily, reducing traffic congestion and pollution. This shift has prompted city planners to reimagine downtown spaces, converting office buildings into residential apartments and recreational facilities. However, this transition creates challenges for local businesses that rely on foot traffic from office workers. Cities must balance economic sustainability with improved quality of life by developing mixed-use communities that attract residents and visitors regardless of traditional work patterns.

questions.q: According to the passage, what is one positive effect of remote work on cities?
options: Higher foot traffic in downtown areas
questions.explanation: 본문에서 '더 적은 직원들이 매일 도심으로 출근하면서 교통 혼잡과 오염이 줄어든다'고 명시되어 있습니다.

questions.q: What challenge is mentioned regarding remote work's impact on cities?
options: Loss of local businesses due to reduced foot traffic
questions.explanation: 본문의 'local businesses that rely on foot traffic from office workers'에서 오피스 근로자의 발길이 줄어들어 지역 사업체가 도전에 직면한다고 설명합니다.

questions.q: What solution does the passage suggest for cities?
questions.explanation: 본문 마지막 부분에서 도시들이 '일과 거주지가 결합된 커뮤니티를 개발'하여 균형을 유지해야 한다고 제시합니다.

writing.prompt: Do you agree or disagree with the statement that remote work will eventually replace traditional office environments entirely?

structure.intro: 자신의 입장을 명확히 제시하되, 'I agree/disagree that...' 형태로 작성. 동시에 원인이나 이유를 간단히 언급하여 에세이의 방향성 제시
structure.body1: 첫 번째 주요 근거 제시: 원격근무의 장점 (비용 절감, 유연성, 글로벌 인재 접근) 또는 단점 (협업 어려움, 팀 문화 약화) 중 선택하여 구체적인 예시와 함께 설명
structure.body2: 두 번째 주요 근거 제시: 산업별 차이, 일자리 특성, 또는 인간관계의 중요성 등 반대 입장을 고려한 균형잡힌 관점 제시
structure.conclusion: 에세이의 주요 입장을 재강조하고, '완전한 대체'보다는 '하이브리드 모델'과 같은 현실적 결론으로 마무리

useful_phrases: In my opinion, remote work will not entirely replace traditional offices because...
Furthermore, certain industries such as healthcare and manufacturing require on-site presence...
One significant advantage of remote work is the reduction in overhead costs...
On the other hand, face-to-face interaction remains crucial for...
In conclusion, a hybrid approach seems to be the most realistic solution...

speaking.prompt: Some people prefer to work in a traditional office environment where they interact face-to-face with colleagues. Others prefer remote work that offers flexibility and independence. Which do you prefer and why?
useful_expressions: In my opinion, I prefer [office/remote work] because...
One reason is that working [in an office/remotely] allows me to...
Another important aspect is that [face-to-face collaboration/flexible scheduling] helps me...
sample_points: 사무실 근무 선호: 팀원들과의 직접적인 상호작용이 창의적 문제 해결을 촉진하고, 회사 문화 형성에 도움이 되며, 멘토링 및 커리어 발전에 유리함
원격 근무 선호: 통근 시간 절약으로 개인 시간 확보, 방해 없는 집중 작업 환경, 일과 삶의 균형 개선, 그리고 지리적 제약 없이 최적의 업무 환경 구성 가능

listening.title: Campus Career Services Discussion
listening.script: Student: Hi, I'm interested in internships for next summer, but I'm not sure where to start. Career Advisor: Great question! Our office has partnerships with over 200 companies in various fields. First, I recommend updating your resume and LinkedIn profile to match the positions you're targeting. Then, attend our internship fair in October where recruiters from major companies will be present. Student: Will they hire based on just meeting them at the fair? Career Advisor: Not necessarily from one meeting, but it's an excellent opportunity to make initial connections and learn about different roles. Follow up with personalized emails within a week. We also offer mock interviews to help you prepare. Most students who participate in our workshops secure internships. Student: That sounds helpful. When do the workshops start? Career Advisor: They begin next month. I'll send you the schedule. Also, consider joining our professional development club to network with upperclassmen who've completed internships.

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the internship fair mentioned in the conversation?
options: To hire students directly for permanent positions
To provide an opportunity for students to meet recruiters and make initial connections
To teach students how to write cover letters
To determine which students are qualified for internships
questions.explanation: 커리어 어드바이저가 'It's an excellent opportunity to make initial connections and learn about different roles'라고 설명하며, 인턴십 페어의 목적이 채용보다는 초기 연결 형성임을 명시합니다.

questions.q: According to the advisor, what should students do after meeting recruiters at the fair?
options: Send personalized follow-up emails within a week
questions.explanation: 어드바이저가 'Follow up with personalized emails within a week'라고 명확히 조언합니다. 이것이 채용 가능성을 높이는 중요한 단계입니다.

questions.q: What does the advisor suggest for additional networking opportunities?
options: Attend the internship fair multiple times
Work with a private career coach
Join the professional development club to network with upperclassmen
questions.explanation: 대화 마지막 부분에서 어드바이저가 'consider joining our professional development club to network with upperclassmen who've completed internships'라고 추천합니다.
